title: Ironstack Meet Record
description: One competition, in any discipline. A meet is a list of EVENTS; each event has a unit and a list of attempts. Powerlifting's squat/bench/deadlift is one shape of that, and the older `attempts` form is still accepted and normalised into events on ingest. kg is the source of truth for weight events; lb is derived by the indexer. Each attempt becomes one workout-meets document.

discipline.description: powerlifting, strongman, weightlifting, or whatever you call yours. Free text: it labels the record and picks nothing by itself. `scoring` is the field that changes behaviour.

scoring.description: How the competition was scored. `total` sums your best made weight attempt on every event - powerlifting, weightlifting - and a projected total is a meaningful thing to compute. `points` scores each event on placing and sums the points, as strongman does: there is no total, and Ironstack will not invent one. This is the only field that changes what the dashboards compute.

total_kg.description: Official total. Computed from best made weight attempts when omitted, and only meaningful when scoring is `total`.

dots.description: Scores a summed total against bodyweight. Meaningless without a total, so it is ignored when scoring is `points`.

points.description: Total competition points, for a points discipline.

events.description: The events of the competition, in running order. Use this OR the legacy `attempts` list, not both.

name.description: The event as the competition called it: Squat, Log Press, Yoke 60ft, Sandbag over bar.

unit.description: What the attempt measures, and which direction is better. kg and reps and m: more is better. seconds: less is better, and only a completed run counts.

lift_name.description: How this event is spelled in your workout logs, so the meet can reach its training history. Resolved through config/exercises.json. Omit it when you do not train the event under a logged name - a medley has no training analogue and does not need a fake one. Given and unresolvable is a hard error: a claimed link that goes nowhere is worse than no link.

attempts.description: One entry for a single-run event; one per bar for a rising-bar event.

made.description: For a timed or rep event: did you complete the run.

result.description: The official result for the event. Computed from the attempts when omitted: the best made value, or the lowest for a seconds event.

attempts.description: LEGACY powerlifting shape, still fully supported. Normalised into three kg events on ingest, so a file written before events existed indexes identically to one written after.

lift_names.description: LEGACY. How each competition lift is named in your workout logs. The events form carries this per event as `lift_name`.
